Every dataset published on benthic.io, and where its documentation lives. Six datasets across two collections; both numbers grow as datasets are added.

Each row is checked by `scripts/check_docs.py` in CI: the reference page, the OpenAPI spec, the signed manifest, and the pipeline README must all exist. If a dataset is added without documentation, the build fails.

## NGOpen

## Reading order

If you are new to the data, read the [APIs overview](https://benthic.io/apis/) first — it has the join paths and worked cross-dataset queries, and it is the only page that explains how the collections fit together.

If you are verifying a dataset, read the [BDP specification](https://benthic.io/bdp/) — it explains what the signatures in the manifest column above actually prove.

If you are running a pipeline, start at the pipeline README. Each documents that dataset's source, its real per-stage behaviour, and the things that will bite you — which is more than the reference page can tell you.
